name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Channel Marketing Manager
summary: B2B marketing and channel partnerships professional with 15+ years across SaaS platforms, combining hands-on channel/reseller partner management with demand generation and CRM architecture. Has run a partner network end to end (onboarding, enablement, retention) and built full-funnel campaign systems tracking ROI and pipeline. Comfortable connecting marketing strategy to regional partner execution and reporting results to both marketing and sales stakeholders.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Develop and execute full-lifecycle customer strategies spanning demand generation, sales CRM architecture, and customer success, demonstrating clear ROI and revenue growth.

Architected and deployed a complete GoHighLevel marketing-automation system - 20+ workflows - spanning lead capture/tagging/routing, qualification, appointment booking, no-show recovery, onboarding nurture, and review-generation sequences.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to executive leadership.
Align marketing programs to revenue objectives directly with business owners and sales teams, producing consistent messaging and qualified lead flow.
Write and publish thought leadership content, newsletters, and educational guides on systems architecture, CRM optimization, and operational growth for B2B audiences.
Track acquisition and retention across multiple accounts using GA4 and CRM analytics, delivering reporting that drives experimentation and growth.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.
Managed integrated digital marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content, coordinating execution across internal departments as strategic lead.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows, equipping them to communicate product value.
Led onboarding and training for a diverse, high-volume partner network, driving rapid adoption of marketing automation and reputation management solutions.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication.
Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each (several exceeding $25K) - roughly $130K+ in total bookings.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years - a team of 20, later a team of 8 - overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped complex CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, with deep fluency in sales enablement, contact management, and pipeline automation.
Advised clients on CRM adoption, building scalable operational systems aligned to their growth stage and team structure.
Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google/Coursera (Sept 2024)
